meta.description: When a group of friends becomes stranded in the Florida backwoods, they stumble upon a murderous swamp cult that sacrifices its victims to an alligator god—and must survive both its masked enforcer and the deadly creatures lurking in the dark.

aside.Starring: Amariah Dionne, Tabitha Brownstone, Ellie Shaddix

meta.name: Prem Keetanu
meta.description: Set against the chaotic charm of UP and NCR (Delhi–Gurgaon), the film blends humour, romance, and nostalgia. The narrative is elevated by a vibrant soundtrack that perfectly complements every mood—college madness, first love, heartbreak, and the bittersweet journey of figuring life out. This rom com is a relatable, entertaining ride about finding love, finding yourself, and laughing through the messiness of growing up.

aside.Starring: Aparshakti Khurana, Veer Pahariya, Aafiya Sayed

meta.name: Psycho
meta.description:
When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes.
Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

aside.Starring: Asem Alawad, Omar Al Mulla, Sandra Hodges

films.title: 18TC SB19 Wakas at Simula: Trilogy Concert

meta.name: SB19 Wakas at Simula: Trilogy Concert
meta.description:
From the Philippines to the world, SB19's historic Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale comes to cinemas worldwide.
Captured before a record breaking crowd of nearly 100,000 fans, the film showcases the group's biggest hits, spectacular production, and world class performances that have made SB19 one of Asia's most influential acts.
Presented in SCREENX and 4DX, audiences can experience the scale, sound, and energy of the concert like never before.
Experience the power of GENTO, What?, and DAM as the Philippines' biggest pop phenomenon takes over the big screen in an unforgettable celebration of music, fandom, and legacy.
More than a concert film, it is the story of a movement—one built by five artists, millions of fans, and a dream that helped redefine Filipino music for a new generation.

aside.Starring: Pablo ,, Josh ,, Justin ,, Stell ,, Ken ,

meta.name: Street Fighter
meta.description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

aside.Starring: Andrew Koji, Noah Centineo, Callina Liang

meta.name: Beware Bouina
meta.description: A team of doctors embarks on a local mission in the Amazon rain forest, but it soon becomes clear that not everybody - or everything - is happy to see them. Their arrival draws the attention of a giant ancient predator, dominant on land and water, who emerges to reclaim the jungle.

aside.Starring: Jessica Rothe, Logan Marshall-Green, Kiana Madeira

meta.name: The Dino Family
meta.description: Phil is an ordinary teenager whose life is overshadowed by personal failures, schoolyard teasing, and the struggles of trying to impress his crush. Everything changes dramatically when he stumbles upon and accidentally opens a hidden portal to go back 65 million years.

aside.Starring: Phil ,, Rina ,, Doc ,

meta.name: Whalefall
meta.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

aside.Starring: Elisabeth Shue, Josh Brolin, Emily Rudd

meta.name: Clayface
meta.description: “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

aside.Starring: Max Minghella, Eddie Marsan, Naomi Ackie, David Dencik

meta.name: Klara and the Sun
meta.description: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams) and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.

aside.Starring: Amy Adams, Jenna Ortega, Mia Tharia

meta.name: The Mongoose
meta.description: Accused of a crime he didn't commit and with nothing to lose, a war hero (Liam Neeson) leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway.

aside.Starring: Marisa Tomei, Ving Rhames, Liam Neeson

meta.name: The Cat In The Hat
meta.description: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don’t know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure with an edge, where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.

aside.Starring: Bill Hader, Xochitl Gomez, Matt Berry

meta.name: Les Misérables
meta.description: An epic new take on Victor Hugo's timeless classic.

aside.Starring: Tahar Rahim, Vincent Lindon, Noémie Merlant

films.title: 18TC The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

meta.name: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
meta.description: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING revisits the world of Panem and follows young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

aside.Starring: Ralph Fiennes, Jesse Plemons, Joseph Zada

meta.name: Focker In-Law
meta.description:
This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar® nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar® winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.

aside.Starring: Robert De Niro, Owen Wilson, Ariana Grande, Ben Stiller

meta.name: Hexed
meta.description: An awkward teen and her Type-A mother learn her peculiarities might be magical powers, transforming their lives and revealing a hidden magical realm.

aside.Starring: Rashida Jones, Hailee Steinfeld, Stephen Fry

meta.name: Violent Night 2
meta.description:
If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice.
 
But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

meta.name: Dune: Part Three
meta.description: Dune: Part Three is based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

aside.Starring: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya ,, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh

meta.name: Avengers: Doomsday
meta.description: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.

aside.Starring: Chris Hemsworth, Robert Downey Jr, Chris Evans, Pedro Pascal

meta.name: Children of Blood and Bone
meta.description: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, CHILDREN OF BLOOD AND BONE features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award® nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award® nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award® winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award® winner Viola Davis.

aside.Starring: Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, Damson Idris, Thuso Mbedu

meta.name: Cocomelon: The Movie
meta.description: When JJ starts kindergarten, his first big day takes an unexpected turn after his beloved teddy bear, Boba, goes missing. Joined by his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina, JJ embarks on a magical adventure to the Kingdom of Melody, where singing has been forbidden by Princess Harmony. Along the way, the friends discover the power of courage, friendship and finding their own voices. Featuring ten brand-new songs, CoComelon: The Movie brings the beloved world of CoComelon to the big screen in an all-new musical adventure for the whole family.

aside.Starring: SZA ,, Ike Barinholtz, Connor Esterson, Sarah Sherman

meta.name: Gatto
meta.description: Indebted to a feline mob boss, a black cat named Nero finds himself forced to forge an unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose.

aside.Starring: Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne, Ismail Elsene
Michael B. Jordan, Kenneth Branagh, Adria Arjona

cinemas.name: ABU DHABI MALL IN ABU DHABI
paras: From the bright and colourful KIDS Cinema to the 20m-wide mega screen in our fabulous MAX theatre, VOX Cinemas at Abu Dhabi Mall brings you all the latest blockbusters in the region’s most modern, high-tech cinema. A blockbuster experience in our MAX theatre puts you right in the heart of the action. You can choose from Standard or Premium View seats with the very best surround sound. Take the kids on an afternoon full of adventure at our KIDS theatre. There’s even a play area for them to let their imagination run wild before settling down to watch their favourite characters on the big screen. Before you head in, grab some sweet treats from the Nutella Bar. You’ll find everything from yummy stuffed crepes to delicious Belgian waffles smothered in gooey Nutella.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: 10th Street, Tourist Club Area, Al Zahiya

cinemas.name: Al Jimi Mall
paras: Whether you’re watching The Avengers’ latest adventure or a Hrithik Roshan action epic, VOX Cinemas at Al Jimi Mall is an experience to remember. Hear every whisper with the latest in audio surround-sound and escape to words unlike anything you’ve seen before with breath taking screens. Treat yourself with our wide variety of delicious snacks and drinks. Get comfortable with our spacious seats. You can’t go wrong at VOX Cinemas, Al Jimi Mall.
SHOWTIMES MAP

cinemas.name: Burjuman
paras: VOX Cinemas is all about creating great moments for everyone, every day. Burjuman is no exception to that rule. At Burjuman, the blockbusters are better, the screens are bigger, and the sound is crisper. Watch Tom Cruise perform his latest stunts in MAX, where Dolby Atmos’ digital surround sound system puts you right in the middle of the action. See Quentin Tarantino’s love letter to Hollywood in GOLD, where fine food and film combine for an unforgettable experience. Laugh with Gru and his Minions as they plan their next heist in KIDS, where the little ones can enjoy their favourite characters in a safe, fun environment.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: Khalid Bin, Al Waleed Rd, Dubai

cinemas.name: City Centre Ajman
paras: City Centre Ajman is quickly proving to be one of the most popular malls in the region, and to add to all the retail available, they’ve also made sure that your entertainment needs are met with a newly expanded VOX Cinemas. You can sit back and enjoy your favourite films in our MAX experience, or you can live the movie with the sensory stimulation in 4DX, exclusive to VOX Cinemas in the region. We haven’t forgotten about the little ones, either. Enjoy the KIDS experience, where children can enjoy the latest animated adventures in a fun and colourful environment. Why not make a birthday celebration really special by booking KIDS for an afternoon party? It’s all on offer at VOX Cinemas, City Centre Ajman.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: Al Ettehad St, Al Jurf, Ajman

cinemas.name: City Centre Deira
paras: VOX Cinemas, City Centre Deira is one of the largest cinemas in the country and home to one of the largest screens in the region, a 408m sq. behemoth. With over twenty screens to choose from, you can’t go wrong at City Centre Deira. Whether you’re watching in MAX – City 101.6, GOLD, 4DX or KIDS, there will always be a spot for you here. Enjoy Shah Rukh Khan’s latest romantic musical or Ahmed Helmy’s wacky comedies in style when you’re at VOX Cinemas.
SHOWTIMES MAP

cinemas.name: City Centre Fujairah
paras: In 2013, His Highness Sheikh Rashid bin Hamad bin Mohammed Al Sharqi opened VOX Cinemas, City Centre Fujairah. It’s the most luxurious cineplex in Fujairah with a massive 20m MAX screen and the esteemed GOLD by Rhodes experience, where you can recline in spacious seats and enjoy the best gourmet cuisine created for VOX Cinemas by Michelin-starred Chef Gary Rhodes. The use of high-tech digital laser projectors and the very latest Dolby Atmos surround-sound systems turn the act of watching a film into a fully immersive experience. Get ready to see Marvel and DC superheroes like you’ve never seen them before, or relax as you watch the latest Arabic-language and Bollywood spectaculars.
SHOWTIMES MAP

cinemas.name: City Centre Mirdif
paras: VOX Cinemas, City Centre Mirdif may be one of the most established cinemas in the UAE, but last year we took it to the next level. We introduced IMAX Sapphire, the first-of-its-kind immersive viewing experience with all-premium seats. We also brought back THEATRE by Rhodes with an all-new design perfect for those who live life lavishly. With over twenty screens, VOX Cinemas at City Centre Mirdif can accommodate over 2,500 guests at a time. Easy access, a private prayer room and plenty of parking make going to the movies at City Centre Mirdif all the more convenient.
SHOWTIMES MAP

cinemas.name: City Centre Sharjah
paras: Whether you’re looking for a premium cinema experience complete with gourmet food and reclining leather seats, or want to see the latest superheroes save the world on a huge 20m-wide MAX screen, VOX Cinemas at City Centre Sharjah is the place to go. This super-complex boasts a fabulous 12 screens, along with everything you want to make a night out something truly special. We haven’t forgotten our young movie buffs either, the colourful KIDS experience can let the little ones feel safe and happy in a bright and fun environment while watching their favourite characters on the big screen. The cinema complex is right in the heart of the mall, which has recently been redesigned to make it lighter, brighter, and more enticing. Parking is easy, with over 1400 parking bays, and a huge range of stores and outlets for you to enjoy.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: Al Wahda Road, Industrial Area 1, Sharjah

cinemas.name: City Centre Shindagha
paras: Located in the Ghubaiba district of Bur Dubai, City Centre Shindagha family-friendly mall with over 75 outlets and stores to browse from. At VOX Cinemas, we’re proud to be a part of this thriving enterprise and offer guests great moments every night of the week. Choose from Arabic extravaganzas, Bollywood spectaculars or Hollywood blockbusters – It’s all on offer here. Parking is easy and convenient, and you’ll find VOX Cinemas at City Centre Shindagha on level one, close to the main entrance. If you feel like leaving the car at home then why not hop on the Dubai Metro and get off at Al Ghubiba station, just a few minutes from the Mall?
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: Al Ghubaiba Rd, Al Shindagha, Dubai

cinemas.name: Mall of the Emirates
paras: Head up to level 2 in the exclusive Mall of the Emirates and you’re in retail heaven. Surrounded by boutiques, shops and great eateries, the VOX cinema complex is the perfect addition to a family day out at the Mall. Drop the kids off to watch the latest Disney animations, while you stroll around the shops in peace!

Covering over 100,000 sq. ft, this is believed to be the largest cinema complex in the whole of the Middle East. 24 screens give you endless choices, showing everything from comedies and kid-friendly films through to fright-fests, action-adventure, or historical dramas.

VOX Cinemas are fitted with the very latest immersive technology, including a laser projection setup that gives you sharper, brighter images and an incredible sensation of being right in the middle of the action.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: Mall of Emirates, Al Barsha 1, Dubai, UAE

cinemas.name: Mercato Mall
paras: Want a cinematic experience that really brings the action to life? At VOX Cinemas, Mercato Mall, we have seven fully renovated theatres with an enhanced, never-to-be-forgotten movie-going sensation. With plenty of food and drinks concessions and easy access, you can turn a simple night out at the movies into something truly special. Treat yourself to our GOLD experience, complete with a diverse menu that features a combination of popular, modern flavours coupled with your favourite cinema classics. With state-of-the-art digital laser projectors and superb quality surround-sound for a fully immersive experience, you can see the latest Arabic, Bollywood and Hollywood films like you’ve never seen them before.
SHOWTIMES MAP

cinemas.name: Nation Towers in Abu Dhabi
paras: VOX Cinemas, Nation Towers redefines ‘movie night’ into something extraordinary. With four THEATRE screens each with premium waiter service, gourmet menu and luxurious reclining leather seats. Digital laser projectors give you the crispest, sharpest picture and Dolby Atmos surround-sound speakers immerse you in sound that’s so clear, it’s as if the characters on-screen are talking to you. VIP guests can use our private lift that takes you directly from the spacious car park directly to the VOX Cinemas foyer – It’s the perfect option for those who prefer a subtle entrance.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: Nation Towers Corniche Road, Abu Dhabi

cinemas.name: Palm Jumeirah Mall
paras: Great news for movie-buffs living on The Palm who fancy a trip to the cinema but don’t want to go too far to catch a show of the latest flick. VOX Cinemas’ 15-screen multiplex opens its doors in Palm Jumeirah Mall this November. Whether you like watching movies on the biggest screen, in a luxurious setting or with the entire family, you’ll find it all in our new cinema.
SHOWTIMES MAP

cinemas.name: The Galleria - Al Maryah Island
paras: VOX Cinemas at The Galleria, Al Maryah Island is the go-to cinema in Abu Dhabi. It’s home to the only full laser IMAX in the city along with an upgraded, luxurious THEATRE and a spacious, colourful and exciting KIDS experience. Don’t know what to snack on during your movie? Browse the countless delicious options from Pizza Al Taglio, The Nutella Bar and VOX Cinemas’ homegrown café concept – Kitchen 35. With over 21 screens to choose from, VOX Cinemas at The Galleria, Al Maryah Island can welcome nearly two thousand people at a time. It’s an experience unlike anything you’ve ever seen before.
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Address: 4th Level, The Galleria, Al Maryah Island ADGM Square, Abu Dhabi

cinemas.name: Yas Mall Abu Dhabi
paras: Abu Dhabi’s cinephiles are in for a treat when they spend their evening at VOX Cinemas, Yas Mall. With twenty screens to choose from, you can try something new every time you visit. Try the 4DX and live the movie. With motion chairs, scent, wind, light and water effects, it is the absolute cinema experience. If you prefer something more intimate and luxurious, try THEATRE. We’ve created an experience that combines the best of fine food and film. Did we mention that there’s plenty of parking, countless shops and great moments at every corner?
SHOWTIMES MAP

kv.Cinema Location: Located on Level 2, Next to the Food Court
